text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Islington Station (Line 2) is being redeveloped as part of the Toronto Transit Commission’s Easier Access program to ensure barrier-free accessibility in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). The project, scheduled from July 2023 to June 2027 includes a new street-level bus terminal, a new station entrance, a new underground pedestrian tunnel and elevators connecting the subway concourse and platform. All construction staging operations will be occur within the site, therefore occupation of the public right-of-way is not required.
